description: This PHP class represents filter parameters for searching employee timesheets in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and provides properties and methods to specify employee numbers and actionable states lists, along with default sorting configuration.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetListSearchFilterParams
classes.description: Defines search filter parameters for employee timesheet listings, including employee numbers, actionable states, and default sorting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field and order.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Returns the list of employee numbers used as filter criteria.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Sets the list of employee numbers to filter by.

methods.name: getActionableStatesList
methods.description: Returns the list of actionable states for filtering.

methods.name: setActionableStatesList
methods.description: Sets the list of actionable states for filtering.
